_provenance.policy: Snapshots record list price only — never promotional, introductory, or time-limited pricing. A model on a temporary discount or an upcoming price increase is still recorded at its current post-introductory list price. Where an entry deviates from its source for this reason, the deviation is stated in that entry's 'note'.
_provenance.attribution: Entries are imported from a third-party, MIT-licensed, community-maintained model-pricing dataset. Portions Copyright (c) 2023 Berri AI; used under the MIT License. MIT requires the permission notice and warranty disclaimer to travel with the copyright line, so the full licence text is reproduced in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md at the crate root — that file must accompany any redistribution of this data or of a binary built with it.
_provenance.revision: Entries carrying verified_on 2026-10-09 or 2026-10-10 were imported from that dataset at commit 4df5006f2955afc2c9a9eed58edafd59ca26f5d8, so this refresh can be re-run and diffed against the same input.
_provenance.field_policy: Every field — per-token pricing, context_window, max_output_tokens, and all multipliers — is carried from the source at the pinned revision. No field is inferred from a prior-generation sibling model, and a model absent from the source is not added from memory. Cache and batch multipliers are derived as ratios of the source's absolute costs; an omitted multiplier is billed at 1.0 by the cost engine, so a multiplier the source provides is always recorded.
_provenance.per_entry_fields: Entries carry optional 'source' (where the figure was actually read: 'aggregated-dataset' for a direct import, a vendor host only where that page was itself fetched), 'verified_on' (ISO date the figure was taken from that source), 'note' (caveats a future reader would otherwise misread as an import error), and 'deprecation_notice' (vendor shutdown date and migration target). A 'source' with no 'verified_on' is a pre-pinning import: the origin is known, the date is not. Earlier revisions of this file spelled some of these with a leading underscore ('_source'); that spelling is retired — the leading underscore now marks file-level metadata only, so '_provenance' is the sole underscored key in the file.
